PostToolUse.description: Structural lint .sty files after edit; lint .lvt files after edit

PreCommit.command: bash -c 'STAGED_STY=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- "*.sty" 2>/dev/null); STAGED_LVT=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- "*.lvt" 2>/dev/null); OK=true; if [ -n "$STAGED_STY" ]; then python3 .claude/scripts/lint_sty_structural.py $STAGED_STY || OK=false; fi; if [ -n "$STAGED_LVT" ]; then .claude/scripts/lint-tests.sh $STAGED_LVT || OK=false; fi; $OK'
PreCommit.description: Lint only staged .sty and .lvt files before commit
